default_done_definition: Ready for orchestrator branch review with lane-local verification complete.

backend-domain.title: Backend domain
test_commands: cd apps/prototype-description-service && VIRTUAL_ENV= uv run --locked --extra dev python -m pytest recognition/tests/unit/test_retention_policy.py recognition/tests/unit/test_audit_events.py recognition/tests/unit/test_export_service.py recognition/tests/unit/test_purge_service.py
cd apps/prototype-description-service && VIRTUAL_ENV= uv run --locked --extra dev mypy recognition/domain/services recognition/infrastructure/repositories recognition/config/settings.py
preflight_commands: cd apps/prototype-description-service && test -f .env && set -a && source .env && set +a && command -v pg_isready >/dev/null && pg_isready -h "${PGHOST:-localhost}" -p "${PGPORT:-5432}" -U "${PGUSER:-postgres}" -d "${DB_NAME:-postgres}"
backend-domain.preflight_failure_summary: backend-domain DB preflight failed; local PostgreSQL or environment setup is not ready for this lane.
backend-domain.preflight_failure_details: The backend-domain lane is allowed to spend tokens only when the local description-service environment and PostgreSQL reset/bootstrap path are available. Fix the preflight issue below or route the next slice to a non-DB-sensitive lane.
non_goals: Do not edit HTTP router files.
Do not edit WordPress or frontend files.

guidance_fallbacks.subject: backend-domain snapshot provenance and disposal
guidance_fallbacks.message: Implement the backend-domain snapshot provenance/disposal slice in apps/prototype-description-service/recognition/infrastructure/repositories/cluster_repository.py and related backend-domain-owned tests/services. Add snapshot_generation_id stamping/return for get_snapshot(), exclude disposed rows from snapshot reads, and keep HTTP analyze.py changes out of this lane.
